Use case: stylized-concept, revised architecture for an anime avatar game room. Reference is earlier design to REVISE, NOT preserve the old glass architecture. Keep its restrained satin white/black PC-case-inspired aluminum, soft anime-game 3D shading, recessed PCB trace aesthetic and cyan/ice-blue/lavender with some pink emissive lines. 
USER'S MANDATORY CORRECTIONS: Actual floor plan is a PERFECT SQUARE, equal side lengths, 9m x 9m, all four walls exactly equal length, 3.5m high. NOT a rectangular tray or elongated room. All FOUR WALLS ARE SOLID OPAQUE architecture. Ceiling is SOLID OPAQUE architecture too. Absolutely NO GLASS, no transparent wall or ceiling panels, no windows, no see-through surfaces, no exterior visible from indoor cameras. This is a fully enclosed square single room. Floor is opaque too. 
Shared floorplan: NORTH wall has ONE wide horizontal inset blank service panel centered and two small blank circular capped mounting plates to its WEST side. WEST wall has THREE narrow vertical flush maintenance panels evenly arranged. EAST wall has ONE broad clean solid flush wall field framed by thin vertical PCB trace clusters, NO big rectangular panel and NO vertical triple panels. SOUTH wall has one CLOSED OPAQUE flush access door near EAST end with a tiny recessed handle, rest solid wall with fine PCB traces. All wall fields solid same palette as floor. Four corners have modest metal uprights and fine vertical ribbed trims. Solid matte ceiling has a simple shallow square inset with slim perimeter light channels, not a glass canopy or reflective mirror. Broad empty flat square floor, perimeter PCB trace clusters, many fine parallel 45/90-degree traces and circular vias, fewer traces in center, no center CPU socket or raised stage. Soft controlled glow and diffuse ambient lighting; reflections subdued. White version pearl satin white and subtle gray joints; black version charcoal/graphite with neutral fill to keep floor visible. No furniture, avatar, actual fan blades, clock, monitor, cables, chips, shelves or bed. Reserved space only for future separate components. No labels/UI/logos/text. Render one standalone landscape 16:9 image.
VIEW 01 MASTER WHITE OVERVIEW: pearl white palette. Exact orthographic isometric view from SOUTH-EAST to NORTH-WEST, camera centered on square's diagonal, no yaw imbalance; north-west rear corner aligned horizontally with southeast near corner at exact image center. Both visible rear wall top edges have EQUAL projected lengths and equal slopes. Floor footprint is a symmetric RHOMBUS representing a 9 x 9 meter PERFECT SQUARE: four equal projected edges, not a rectangle. North solid wall appears RIGHT, west solid wall LEFT. Whole floor visible. Architect's cutaway visualization ONLY: REMOVE ceiling entirely and clip SOUTH and EAST front opaque walls to 15cm tall SOLID WHITE cutaway stubs; this does not mean real walls are short or transparent. Do not leave any front tall glass uprights or glass rails. Both rear walls stay fully opaque at full height. Plain cool neutral studio backdrop outside cutaway. Keep the floor polygon clean and symmetrical. Frame entire room comfortably with margins. Existing reference is ONLY material/detail style, actively correct its elongated geometry and remove every glass element. No dimensions or diagram labels.
